obsah:
September was all about pump track openings, racing and big exhibitions across the country. Martin Šimůnek and Michal Budský headed to a big Moravian-Silesian Region event at Trojhalí in Ostrava, where lots of concerts, workshops and performances took place in a beautiful setting.


The guys moved smoothly on to Strážnice, where the end of the cycling season was being celebrated, and again provided the local programme with two exhibition shows and a workshop, including hosting and the sound system.


Meanwhile Vlasta and Dalibor Šulc loaded the bikes and motorbikes and headed for Vísky u Letovic for the local village festival, where they put on exhibitions for a large audience from far and wide. They also battled the gravel, which complicated our show a little. Vlasta then went with the club kids to races in Thalheim, Germany, and the week before he did a marathon of coaching and more races in Slovakia.


At the beginning of October there was a big pump track opening in Prague-Klánovice. For Katarína Tóthová it was already one of several in a row, but this time, together with Vlasta and Marty, their task was to provide a complete 2-hour programme of exhibition, workshop and coaching – and they even threw in a mini race for the kids who came.


In October we also have the completion of the Říčany trail repairs, probably another Prague pump track opening and a club race in Tehov.
